component.name: Liquid Metal
component.description: Animated liquid-metal border effect (metal-fx). Wrap any element — a button, link, or icon — with a live metallic ring driven by a shared WebGL renderer. Three presets (chromatic, silver, gold), button and circle variants, adjustable strength, glow and proximity reflections, theme-aware (auto/dark/light).
